name: Barret Schloerke
title: Senior Software Engineer, Posit
summary: Software engineer at Posit, where I build and maintain tools in the Shiny ecosystem for both R and Python, including shiny, py-shiny, shinytest2, shinylive, plumber, and reactlog. Lately that means OpenTelemetry for Shiny, LLM-powered apps, and custom UI with React. PhD in Statistics from Purdue University, focused on large data visualization.

notes: Advisors: William Cleveland and Ryan Hafen. Emphasis: large data visualization.
National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellow (2012 – 2017).
Statistics graphics research with Dianne Cook and Heike Hofmann.

bullets: Core developer of Shiny for Python, a framework for building interactive web apps straight from Python.
Architected Playwright testing controllers for every Shiny for Python UI component, run by 1000+ pytest tests across parallel CI workers.
Built shinylive for R and Python, which export Shiny apps to static sites that run in the browser with WebAssembly.
Lately: OpenTelemetry for Shiny, LLM-powered apps (querychat, shinychat), and custom Shiny UI with React (shinyreact).
Core developer of Shiny, an R package for building interactive web apps straight from R.
Architected and automated nightly testing of 150+ Shiny apps with GitHub Actions on Mac, Windows, and Linux across 5 R versions (shinycoreci).
Converted Shiny's core JavaScript to TypeScript.
Maintained plumber (R web APIs), reactlog (reactivity visualizer), shinytest2, and dozens of packages in the Shiny ecosystem.
Produced custom summary statistics for 75+ datasets to feed visualization apps.
Kept data secure while coordinating with five other data scientists.
Created and maintained template R packages for standardized package development.

experience.role: Researcher, DARPA XDATA and D3M grants
bullets: Worked remotely with Hafen Consulting, Kitware, and KnowledgeVis on a web interface for subject matter experts to explore machine learning pipelines.
Lead point of contact for integrating services with other working groups.
Built interactive D3 visualizations on DVL, a reactive data visualization library, in CoffeeScript.
Wrote Node.js front-end servers: automated deploys, server clusters, and company / user management.
Cut site startup time and trimmed data queries to reduce server load.
Built a Gantt chart tool showing employee availability for management.
Wrote a web tutorial of common graphics as reusable plotting layers.
